name: Kadenokouji Ichijiku
original_name: 勘解由小路 無花果
source: The de facto No. 2 in the political party Party of Words. She is the core member of the Party, directing all policies. She is indebted to the party leader, Otome Tohoten, and worships her from the bottom of her heart. She hated men with all her heart, [spoiler]and used to treat the clone Ramuda as an object, but after seeing Otome’s changes and hearing Nemu's thoughts, she began to show her true gentle side.[/spoiler]
translation: The de facto No. 2 in the political party Party of Words. She is the core member of the Party, directing all policies. She is indebted to the party leader, Otome Tohoten, and worships her from the bottom of her heart. She hated men with all her heart, [spoiler]and used to treat the clone Ramuda as an object, but after seeing Otome’s changes and hearing Nemu's thoughts, she began to show her true gentle side.[/spoiler]
